footer.finePrint: harumin never keeps message text and never hosts beatmaps. Not affiliated with or endorsed by ppy Pty Ltd or Discord. osu! is a trademark of ppy Pty Ltd.

home.title: The osu! bot that reads the room.
home.lead: Profiles, recent plays, top plays and pp for your Discord server. Link a map once and every command knows which one you mean.

remembers.title: It remembers the map
remembers.body: Someone links a beatmap and the channel keeps it. /score, /map, /leaderboard and /simulate work on it without pasting the link again. Matches, packs and pools too.

pp.title: pp, worked out on the spot
pp.body: Full-combo pp on every recent play, pp from 95 to 100% on map cards, /nochoke for your top 100, and /simulate. Computed with rosu-pp, the same calculator tosu uses.

cards.title: Cards your server picks
cards.body: Beatmap, match, pack and pool links get a card. Server managers switch each kind on or off from the dashboard.

home.toolsLead: harumin is part of haruhime.moe, osu! tools for players, mappers and tournament hosts. One account links them all: sign in with osu! once, link Discord, done.

tools.packs: Pack links and pack keys open as a card with every map. /pack does the same.
tools.pools: /pool view shows a pool by slot. /pool check runs osu!'s content rules over every map.
tools.bb: Template links get a small preview, if your server turns them on.

demo.label: Sample Discord conversation with harumin
demo.question: is this one ok for the pool??
demo.caption: No map given to /score. The channel remembered it.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.lead: Signed in as {username}. Pick a server to set up.
dashboard.linkFirstBody: Your haruhime account has no Discord linked, so harumin can't tell which servers are yours. Link it, then come back.
dashboard.offlineBody: The dashboard asks the bot which servers you manage, and it's offline right now. Try again in a minute.
dashboard.noServersBody: You'll see servers here where harumin is a member and you have Manage Server.

result.no-discord: Sign in and link Discord on haruhime.moe first.
result.offline: harumin isn't answering right now, so nothing was saved. Try again in a minute.
result.forbidden: You need Manage Server in that server, and harumin has to be in it.
result.invalid: Those settings don't look right. Reload and try again.
result.saved: Saved. harumin uses the new settings within a minute.

settings.cardsLead: When someone posts one of these links, harumin answers with a card. Commands work either way.

map.name: Beatmaps
map.line: osu.ppy.sh beatmap links get a map card.

match.name: Matches
match.line: Multiplayer match links get a summary with match costs.

pack.name: Packs
pack.line: packs.haruhime.moe links get a pack card.

pool.name: Pools
pool.line: pools.haruhime.moe links get a pool card.

bb.name: BBCode
bb.line: bb.haruhime.moe links get a small preview.

replay.name: Replays
replay.line: .osr files get a score card and a render button.

settings.rulesetLead: For commands where nobody picks a mode. "Player's own" uses each player's main mode.

guild.offlineBody: Settings need the bot to confirm you manage this server, and it's offline right now. Try again in a minute.
guild.trackedLead: New top plays get posted to these channels. Add and remove them with /track in Discord.

result.set-link: Use a difficulty link (one with #osu/ and an id), or the id.
result.not-a-map: That isn't a beatmap link or id.

card.title: Your card
card.previewSoon: Preview arrives with the signature banner.
card.accentLead: Colors your pp, the rule under your name, and the favorite line.
card.favoriteLead: A difficulty link or id. /osu shows your best score on it. Leave it empty for none.

commands.title: Commands
commands.lead: Player options default to your linked account. Map options default to the last map in the channel. <star>*</star> means required.

brand.title: Brand
brand.lead: The harumin name, logos, colors and type.

legal.lead: The terms, and what harumin keeps and why.

bbCard.anOsuBbcodeTemplate: An osu! BBCode template. Open it to preview, copy or remix.

infoCard.anOsuBotFrom: An osu! bot from haruhime.moe, for players, mappers and tournament hosts.

inviteCard.profilesScoresMapsMatch: Profiles, scores, maps, match costs and pools, in your osu! server.

linkCard.commandsUseThisAccount: Commands use this account when you leave the player empty.
linkCard.signInWithOsu: Sign in with osu! on haruhime.moe, then link Discord there.

serverCard.nobodyHereHasLinked: Nobody here has linked an osu! account yet.

simulateCard.ifYouPlayedIt: If you played it like this

tracksCard.nobodyYetTrackAdd: Nobody yet. /track add posts a player's new top plays.
